public_rationale: The claim says every single major bank and financial institution has put hundreds of millions or billions into data centers that are slow to earn money and then 'only seem to lose it.' An October 12, 2026 summary of a Bloomberg report says lenders led by JPMorgan and MUFG syndicated a record $38 billion construction loan for Oracle-leased data centers in Texas and Wisconsin. More than two dozen banks and investors joined it, including Wells Fargo, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, Sumitomo Mitsui and Societe Generale (e1). This is context for the financing part only. 'Every single major bank and financial institution' names no defined set to check. 'Take forever' has no measure. 'Only seem to lose it' is a hedged impression, not a firm claim that the projects lose money. The packet contains no revenue or profit data for any financed data center. Under the contract, the claim is not scored.
limitations: e1 covers one loan and is a secondary summary of a Bloomberg report.
The packet does not show each institution's exposure or how much each one lent.
The packet has no operating results for any bank-financed data center, so it does not show whether such projects earn or lose money.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every single major bank and financial institution has put hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars into building data centers that take forever to start generating money and then only seem to lose it.
conditions: every single major bank and financial institution

statement.excerpt: Every single major bank and financial institution has piled hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars into building data centers that take forever to even start generating money, at which point they only seem to lose it.

from_speaker: Every single major bank and financial institution
piled hundreds of millions if not billions of dollars
take forever to even start generating money
at which point they only seem to lose it
our_interpretation: The claim has two parts: that every major bank and financial institution has put at least hundreds of millions into data center construction, and that those data centers take a long time to earn money and then 'seem' to lose it.
'Every single major bank and financial institution' names no defined set, so the universal cannot be checked institution by institution.
'Only seem to lose it' is an impression, not a firm claim that the projects are loss-making. Treating it as a firm loss claim would drop his hedge.
Project-level revenue and profit for bank-financed data centers are generally not public.
criteria.support_condition: Would require a defined list of major banks and institutions each shown to have committed hundreds of millions or more to data center construction, plus public operating results showing the financed facilities lag on revenue and then run losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Would require a clearly major bank shown to have no meaningful data center exposure, or financed AI data centers shown to earn money quickly and profitably.
